paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : GPT-4o-mini
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the informativeness score of three different models across a range of input lengths. The x-axis is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, with tick labels spaced every 1 unit. The y-axis represents the informativeness score, ranging from 0.920 to 0.950 in increments of 0.005, and is labeled “Informativeness”. A blue dashed line represents the 0-CoT model, beginning at approximately 0.920 and decreasing to a value of 0.915 at the end of the x-axis. A orange solid line represents the CoRe model, beginning at approximately 0.948 and decreasing to a value of 0.943 at the end of the x-axis.
